meta.rule: All activities within ~60 min by metro/bus/high-speed rail from Bund / People's Square hotel base

activities.name: The Bund promenade (外滩)
activities.travel_from_base: ~10 min walk from Bund hotels; Line 2/10 East Nanjing Road
activities.exceptions: Individual buildings have separate hours; HSBC lobby business hours only; river cruises/tunnel ticketed separately

activities.name: Yu Garden (豫园) classical garden + Yuyuan Bazaar
activities.travel_from_base: Line 10/14 Yuyuan Garden, ~15 min from Bund
activities.days_open: Tue–Sun (closed Mon except national holidays) — verify; Bazaar open daily
activities.hours: Garden ~08:30–17:00 (last entry ~16:30); Bazaar until ~22:00. NOTE: sources vary (09:00–16:30 also listed) — check official WeChat mini-program before travel.
activities.exceptions: Lantern Festival (Jan–Feb) timed entry ~¥80; arrive at opening to avoid tour-group crowds

activities.name: Shanghai Museum (People's Square)
activities.travel_from_base: Line 1/2/8 People's Square, ~10 min from Nanjing Road hotels
activities.exceptions: Free timed ticket via official WeChat mini-program (overseas via Trip.com); bring passport; groups 20+ phone-book 7 days ahead

activities.name: Oriental Pearl Tower (东方明珠)
activities.travel_from_base: Line 2/14 Lujiazui, ~20 min from Bund (ferry/tunnel option)
activities.hours: 09:00–21:00 (last entry 20:30); glass walkway may close in bad weather
activities.exceptions: Ticket tiers: ~¥199 (middle+lower spheres) / ~¥299 (three spheres); single entry only; passport required

activities.name: Shanghai Tower observation deck (上海中心大厦, 118F)
activities.hours: 08:30–22:00 (last entry 21:30) per most sources; some list 10:00–21:00 — check official site before travel
activities.exceptions: Adult ~¥180 (¥199 holidays); timed slot; passport/ID required; book online to skip queues

activities.name: Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street (南京路步行街)
activities.travel_from_base: Line 2/10 East Nanjing Road; Line 1/2/8 People's Square
activities.hours: Street open 24h; shops typically ~09:00–22:00 (varies by store)
activities.exceptions: Crowded evenings/weekends; Yunnan Road food street nearby

activities.name: Xintiandi (新天地)
activities.travel_from_base: Line 10/12 South Shaanxi Road, ~15 min from People's Square

activities.name: French Concession (法租界) — Wukang Road / Anfu Road
activities.travel_from_base: Line 1/10/12 Shaanxi South Road, ~20 min from People's Square

activities.name: Huangpu River cruise (浦江游览)
activities.travel_from_base: Walk from Bund hotels; Line 2/10 East Nanjing Road
activities.hours: Day + night sailings; night cruise ~18:00–22:00 (check pier schedule)
activities.exceptions: Suspended in severe weather; night cruise popular — book ahead

activities.name: Suzhou day trip (苏州) — gardens + Pingjiang Road
activities.travel_from_base: Shanghai Hongqiao → Suzhou ~25–30 min by G-train (within 1-hr rule)
activities.days_open: Daily (gardens Tue–Sun pattern varies — check each garden)
activities.hours: Gardens typically 07:30–17:00 (varies); Pingjiang Road open air 24h
activities.exceptions: Garden tickets timed; book via official mini-programs; return trains fill on weekends

activities.name: Hangzhou day trip (杭州) — West Lake
activities.travel_from_base: Shanghai Hongqiao → Hangzhou East ~45–60 min by G-train (at 1-hr limit)
activities.exceptions: Longer day; consider overnight if adding Lingyin Temple + tea village

activities.name: Power Station of Art (上海当代艺术博物馆)
activities.travel_from_base: Line 4/8 South Xizang Road + walk, ~30 min from People's Square
activities.exceptions: Free general entry; special exhibitions ticketed
